messages:
Priya (Infra PM): quick follow-up from today's all-hands slide on APAC capacity: can leadership confirm what 'burst credits' mean for customer routing? a few folks asked whether credits change spill behavior or just billing. cc @Carlos

Carlos (VP Infra): good question. burst credits are an accounting abstraction we give to select customers to absorb short-term bursts into the warm-pool without immediately increasing their billed committed capacity. routing still follows the same priority order; credits only affect whether we pull from dedicated warm slots vs billed warm usage.

Evan (SRE): ops detail: routing priority is regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt. if a customer has burst credits and warm_pool is at capacity, we will temporarily allocate a warm slot out of the warm-reserve and decrement their credit balance. no change to preempt detection.

Nora (Platform): console note: we'll add a new column `route.burst_credits` and an API flag `allocate_from_burst=true` in the next deploy. example API call: `PATCH /routes/<id> { \"allocate_from_burst\": true }`. ETA next Thursday.

Ruth (Support): for support messaging: what's a one-line we can use for customers who see a spill but have burst credits? non-tech wording please.

Carlos (VP Infra): suggestion: \"We reserve a small buffer of warm capacity for short regional surges; if you have burst credits, those are used to keep your traffic on our local warm pool.\"

Priya (Infra PM): action items: 1) Nora to share console mock for burst credits 2) Evan to validate warm-reserve accounting in staging 3) Priya to draft customer FAQ & CS template. target: EOD Tue.

Evan (SRE): testing tip: use `infra/tests/sim_burst --region=apac1 --credits=3 --duration=120` to simulate 3 credit allocations over 2 minutes. this will show `burst_allocations` in the logs.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: autoscaler/v3 -> staging at 2024-10-02T11:02:00Z. watch: warm-reserve-util, burst-allocations. :robot_face:

Nora (Platform): billing note: burst credit usage is reflected in the usage export as `usage_type=burst_warm`; finance will reconcile to invoices as a line item. we'll add mapping to the billing docs.

Ruth (Support): one more ask: if a customer requests guaranteed regional SLA (paid add-on), how quickly can we provision?

Carlos (VP Infra): with procurement and the warm-pool pilot we can provision guaranteed regional SLA in ~2 weeks for 1-2 customers (depends on rack availability). this is a paid add-on that reserves N dedicated warm slots per region. we'll propose pricing cadence next week.

Priya (Infra PM): note for leadership: please confirm interest in a 2-customer pilot so we can allocate one APAC rack for Q1. I'm collecting names.

Evan (SRE): ops runbook pointer: add a recovery step for \"burst-credit-debt\" state 14 where a customer's credits are exhausted during sustained load; recommended mitigation is to auto-fall back to `prefer_cost` or throttle non-critical routes. I filed PR infra/runbooks/burst-credit.md -> staging.

Carlos (VP Infra): thanks everyone. procurement update: we've expedited an RFX for APAC boards; if that lands, we can scale warm-pool capacity by ~30% in Q2. I'll update next all-hands.

Priya (Infra PM): thanks 31; I'll consolidate and post the FAQ draft here. if anyone has further follow-ups, drop them and I'll triage.
